title: Live files E: end-to-end scenarios and the live proof on development
description:
Contract: docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md sections 13 (LF-46), 15 (E) and 17. Whoever finishes second of A2 and C does this.

Work: write the three @end-to-end scenarios of features/computer_file_live.feature in one steps file (conversation/features-support/steps/computer-file-live-end-to-end.steps.ts) using the real supervisor, the real file helper and real bot turns (see computer_owner_long_lived.feature for the shape); put them in features/cucumber-features.txt. Then run the live proof of section 17 on development (eight checks; record each result in a Kanbus comment, including the memory measurement and the CloudFront If-Match / ETag check). Then launch the Kanbus-and-README milestone sub-agent required by AGENTS.md: README "What is live today", this ticket and its siblings, a closing comment on chatticus-041a10.

Acceptance: npm run test:features green with all tags of computer_file_live.feature in the list; live proof recorded; unwire blocked-by edges when closing (CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md).

Dependencies: A2 and C merged and deployed. Related: chatticus-c24177 (Phase 2a live proofs).
right_now_summary: The team is adding live file scenarios, testing them on development, and recording the results.
